name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders for blocks, text lines and avatars, with a shimmer that sweeps through the dither levels.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A generative avatar drawn from a string as a mirrored dither face, with an overlapping avatar group.

name: loader
title: Loader
description: A small dithered loading indicator: ring, dot matrix, bar scanner or dissolving square.

name: divider
title: Divider
description: A horizontal or vertical dithered rule with fading ends and an optional label.

name: dither-card
title: Dither card
description: A card surface with a dithered glow in a corner or along an edge, which can grow on hover.

name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: A dithered illustration with a title, a description and an action, for views with nothing in them yet.

name: not-found
title: Not found
description: A complete 404 block with a big dithered code, a message and actions.

name: dither-button
title: Dither button
description: A button filled with a dither texture in any palette colour that grows denser on hover and press, with sizes, loading and asChild.
